physicalNotes: No radius or mass of the Leo Cluster is recorded: it is an extended cluster of galaxies, and its package frames it at 1384100 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), a presentation value: 1.5 times its R500 radius (0.9034 Mpc, MCXC-II) in comoving units, as the galaxy cluster catalogue frames its rows.
